gain.title: Gain in the app
gain.description: Gain changes from 0 to -60 dB at 3.2 seconds. More negative values make it quieter. The control appears briefly, then the view returns to the top visual while the synthetic audio continues.

gain.title: Browse Properties
gain.description: A silent recording of the real Gain Properties panel. The view browses its settings and returns to the top. Device, network and plugin operation are not demonstrated by this configuration overview.
